title: Geodetic survey mark outside The Riverhead, Auckland
altText: Close photograph of a geodetic survey mark near The Riverhead building in Auckland.
caption: Photograph of a physical geodetic survey mark outside The Riverhead building in Riverhead, Auckland, in February 2025.
context: Illustrates the visible survey marks used to relate measured positions to geodetic reference frameworks. The mark's actual NZGD2000 status has not been checked and must not be asserted.
